02 / A DIFFERENT WAY TO SEE NATURE

One tree.
So many possibilities.

Take the banana tree. Its fruit, flower, stem and leaves each have a place in our food traditions. An everyday tree, with an extraordinary story.

That curiosity is at the heart of NATIVE NATURE: seeing the possibilities in familiar ingredients and exploring what they can become.

03 / OUR ROOTS

Native ingredients.
New possibilities.

We are Senthoor Products India.
Meet our brand, NATIVE NATURE.

Based in Kurinjipadi, Tamil Nadu, we manufacture agri value-added products under the NATIVE NATURE brand. Our world of ingredients spans fruits, nuts, dry fruits, spices, roots, rice and seafood.

Our idea is simple: begin with familiar ingredients and explore more ways to bring them into everyday life.

Rooted in nature.
Growing with possibility.
